Definition: a descent; as architecture, an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon
BiblicalUsage: Morad is a descent, a going down — the Amorites flee down the descent of Beth-horon under hailstones from heaven, the men of Ai chase Israel down the same kind of slope, and the mountains melt beneath the LORD like wax.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the descents are where battles are decided: going down is easy, and God meets His people on the slope.
RelatedTopics: Victory; God Fights for Us; Judgment
